notes: EXAMPLE DATA. Crate types, inflows (crates/hour), pallet quantities, offsets, shaft capacities, and shuttle kinematics are illustrative assumptions for this prototype. They are not measurements from a warehouse. Indexes in these files are one-based (segment 1 is the leftmost rack). expectedPullWaitSeconds is a planning input for shaft sizing. Annealing weights are dimensionless relative weights on pull-seconds, imbalance, and shared-zone traffic.
